meta.name: Sathish Chakali
meta.tagline: Building agentic systems — RAG, tool-calling via MCP, and fine-tuned LLMs — backed by production-grade API and data engineering discipline.

hero.summary: I design and ship agentic AI systems end-to-end — retrieval-augmented generation, tool-calling via MCP, and NL-to-SQL pipelines with guardrails — and bring the same production discipline from my Oracle PL/SQL work at Accenture into every model-backed app I deploy.

paragraphs: I'm an AI/ML engineer building agentic systems — from a fully local pipeline that turns natural language into validated SQL, retrieves answers via RAG over a vector database, and exposes it all as callable tools through an MCP server, to LLM-graded applications and n8n-based automation. Alongside this, I have nearly 2 years of production engineering experience at Accenture (Oct 2024 – Aug 2026), working on Oracle-based data warehouse systems.

My flagship project, Local Agent Pipeline, combines natural-language-to-SQL generation (validated by a read-only SqlGuard before execution), semantic search over thousands of transcript chunks via ChromaDB, an MCP server that exposes these capabilities as tools any agent can call, and a two-tier memory + SQLite cache — built with FastAPI and deployed on Render. It's the clearest expression of how I think about AI engineering: retrieval and generation are only half the system — validation, caching, and tool interfaces are what make it production-ready.

In my day-to-day role at Accenture, I work on Oracle-based data warehouse systems in a production ETL environment — building PL/SQL packages, tuning SQL performance, and resolving data-load failures within SLA. That same discipline around validation, exception handling, and reliability is what I apply to LLM pipelines: guardrails around generated SQL, structured retrieval instead of raw prompt stuffing, and caching layers that make agentic systems fast enough to actually use.
focusAreas: Agentic AI systems — RAG, tool-calling, MCP servers, multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph)

resumeSummary: AI/ML engineer with nearly 2 years of production engineering experience at Accenture (Oct 2024 – Aug 2026), building agentic AI systems end-to-end alongside production Oracle PL/SQL work. Built and deployed Local Agent Pipeline — a fully local agentic system combining NL-to-SQL generation validated by a read-only SqlGuard, semantic search over 5,500+ transcript chunks via ChromaDB (RAG), an MCP server exposing tools for agent use, and a two-tier memory + SQLite cache, built with FastAPI and deployed via Docker on Render. Also shipped a full MERN-stack SaaS mock interview platform with JWT authentication and live LLM-based grading (Groq/Llama), an Oracle ETL data warehouse pipeline with production-style exception handling, a documented SQL performance tuning case study, and an n8n + LLM incident-triage automation — all version-controlled on GitHub, several with live public deployments on Render. Comfortable taking AI-backed systems from local development to publicly accessible, production deployments end-to-end. Java Full Stack Certified (Wipro TalentNext), AI/ML Virtual Internship Certified; eager to grow with a team building applied AI systems.

projects.title: Local Agent Pipeline — NL-to-SQL + RAG + MCP
projects.description: A fully local agentic pipeline over NASA mission data: natural-language-to-SQL generation validated by a read-only SqlGuard, semantic search over 5,500+ transcript chunks via ChromaDB, an MCP server exposing it all as callable tools, and a two-tier (memory + SQLite) cache. Built with FastAPI, containerized with Docker, and deployed on Render.

projects.title: Job Search Agent — Multi-Agent LangGraph Pipeline
projects.description: A multi-agent job search system built on LangGraph: agents search across Remotive, Adzuna, and Apify-scraped LinkedIn/Naukri listings, an LLM ranking agent scores fit against the candidate's resume, and a deterministic ATS keyword-matching agent (mirroring how real applicant tracking systems screen resumes) filters and surfaces only the strongest matches. Includes on-demand resume tailoring toward a target ATS score with a truthfulness guardrail (never fabricates skills), live incremental result streaming, and a React dashboard.
projects.resumeDescription: Multi-agent job search pipeline (LangGraph): search agents across Remotive/Adzuna/Apify (LinkedIn, Naukri), an LLM fit-ranking agent, and a deterministic ATS keyword-matching agent mirroring real applicant tracking systems; on-demand ATS-targeted resume tailoring with a truthfulness guardrail, live streaming results, FastAPI + React, deployed on Render
